title: Sri Lanka vs Bali: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Sri Lanka for wildlife, adventure, and authenticity. Bali for food variety, tourist ease, and beach clubs. Budget: Sri Lanka $40-80/day vs Bali $60-100/day.

categories.name: Daily Budget
categories.summary: Sri Lanka runs $40-80/day vs Bali $60-100. Safaris add cost but train travel is almost free.

categories.name: Wildlife
categories.summary: Sri Lanka has leopards (Yala), wild elephants (Udawalawe), and blue whales (Mirissa). Bali has monkey forests.

categories.name: Culture & History
categories.summary: Sri Lanka: ancient UNESCO ruins, colonial forts. Bali: 20,000+ living temples, daily ceremonies.

categories.name: Food Scene
categories.summary: Bali has world-class variety. Sri Lanka has exceptional traditional cuisine at lower prices.

categories.name: Beaches & Surf
categories.summary: Bali: Uluwatu surf, beach clubs. Sri Lanka: Arugam Bay uncrowded surf, Mirissa whale watching.

categories.name: Getting Around
categories.summary: Bali is easier. Sri Lanka requires more planning but has the legendary Kandy-Ella train journey.

categories.name: Tourist Infrastructure
categories.summary: Bali is world-class and seamless. Sri Lanka is good and rapidly improving.

categories.name: Authenticity
categories.summary: Sri Lanka is less developed for mass tourism — closer to the real thing.

faq.question: Is Sri Lanka or Bali better for first-time visitors?
faq.answer: Bali is marginally easier; Sri Lanka rewards extra planning.

faq.question: Is Sri Lanka cheaper than Bali?
faq.answer: Yes — Sri Lanka runs $40-80/day vs Bali $60-100/day.

faq.question: Which has better wildlife?
faq.answer: Sri Lanka wins easily with leopards, wild elephants, and blue whales.

faq.question: Can you combine both in one trip?
faq.answer: Yes — fly via Singapore or KL. 10 days Sri Lanka + 7 days Bali is ideal.
